q: 你今天头疼___？
en: Do you have a headache today?

q: 你哪儿不舒服___？
en: Where do you feel unwell?

q: 你昨天晚上睡得好不好___？
en: Did you sleep well last night?

q: 我刚搬来这儿，不知道这里的冬天比北京冷___？
en: I just moved here and do not know: is the winter here colder than in Beijing?

q: 医生，我这个病需要住院___？
en: Doctor, do I need to be admitted to hospital?

q: 你是想知道明天会不会下雪___？
en: Do you want to know whether it will snow tomorrow?

q: 你知道医院附近哪儿有药店___？
en: Do you know where there is a pharmacy near the hospital?

q: 你感冒___吗？
en: Have you caught a cold?

q: 我有点儿头疼，你___？
en: I have a bit of a headache. What about you?

q: 我的雨伞___？
en: Where is my umbrella?

q: 今天下雨，明天___？
en: It is raining today. What about tomorrow?

q: 春天很短，你们那儿的秋天___？
en: Spring is short. What about autumn where you are?

q: 这么冷的天，你怎么还穿短袖___？
en: It is so cold. Why are you still in short sleeves?

q: 医生让你每天吃几次药___？
en: How many times a day did the doctor tell you to take the medicine?

q: 要是明天还下雨，我们的运动会该怎么办___？
en: If it still rains tomorrow, what are we going to do about the sports day?

q: 你到底是头疼还是肚子疼___？
en: Is it your head or your stomach that hurts, exactly?

q: 别进去，医生在看病___。
en: Do not go in; the doctor is seeing a patient.

q: 我还没吃药___。
en: I have not taken my medicine yet.

q: 外面刮着大风___。
en: It is blowing a gale outside.

q: 现在才十月___，怎么就穿羽绒服了？
en: It is only October. Why are you in a down jacket already?

q: 他还没退烧___，不能去上学。
en: His fever has not come down yet, so he cannot go to school.

q: 我正在量体温___，你等一下。
en: I am taking my temperature right now; wait a moment.

q: 山上还下着雪___，路不好走。
en: It is still snowing up in the mountains, so the road is hard to walk.

q: 这点儿雨算什么？我才不怕___！
en: What is a bit of rain? I am certainly not afraid!

q: 现在是三伏天，最热的时候还没到___，你就受不了了？
en: It is the dog days, but the hottest time has not even come yet, and you cannot stand it already?

q: 医生说他的病还没好___，你怎么能让他出门吹风？
en: The doctor said he is not better yet, so how can you let him go out in the wind?

q: 天冷了，你多穿一件衣服___。
en: It is cold; put on another layer.

q: 我们去公园走走___。
en: Let us take a walk in the park.

q: 你感冒了，今天请假在家休息___。
en: You have a cold; take the day off and rest at home.

q: 雨太大了，我们等雨停了再走___。
en: The rain is too heavy; let us wait until it stops before leaving.

q: 我真不想去医院，不过你说得对。好___，我明天就去。
en: I really do not want to go to the hospital, but you are right. All right then, I will go tomorrow.

q: 这个药很苦，你捏着鼻子一口喝下去___。
en: This medicine is bitter; hold your nose and drink it down in one go.

q: 明天的天气预报说有大雨，我们把爬山的计划改到下个周末___。
en: The forecast says heavy rain tomorrow; let us move the hiking plan to next weekend.

q: 你已经咳嗽一个星期了，别再拖了，今天下午就去看医生___。
en: You have been coughing for a week; stop putting it off and go and see a doctor this afternoon.

q: 你的脸很红，你发烧了___？
en: Your face is very red; you have a fever, haven't you?

q: 今天好冷，你也觉得冷___？
en: It is so cold today; you think so too, right?

q: 他大概感冒了___，一直在咳嗽。
en: He has probably caught a cold, I suppose; he keeps coughing.

q: 这个周末应该不会下雨了___？
en: It should not rain this weekend, should it?

q: 你每天都跑步，身体一定很好___？
en: You run every day, so you must be very healthy, I suppose?

q: 你的腿疼了好几天了，你一定没有好好休息___？
en: Your leg has hurt for days; you surely have not been resting properly, have you?

q: 我看你脸色不太好，昨天晚上大概没睡好___？
en: You do not look well; you probably did not sleep well last night, I take it?

q: 今年夏天比去年热得多，空调的电费应该不便宜___？
en: This summer is much hotter than last year; the air-conditioning bill must be steep, I suppose?

q: 今天的天气多好___！
en: What lovely weather today!

q: 雪下得真大___！
en: It is snowing so hard!

q: 快穿上外套___，外面很冷！
en: Hurry and put on your coat; it is cold outside!

q: 今年的秋天真舒服。——是___，比往年凉快多了。
en: "This autumn is really pleasant." "Yes, it is much cooler than in previous years."

q: 您多保重身体___，别太累了！
en: Take good care of yourself and do not get too tired!

q: 你看，雨后的空气多新鲜___，咱们出去走走吧！
en: Look, how fresh the air is after the rain! Let us go out for a walk.

q: 能在这么热的天气里喝上一杯冰水，真是舒服___！
en: What a pleasure to have a glass of iced water in such hot weather!

q: 生病了当然要吃药___。
en: Of course you have to take medicine when you are ill.

q: 冷就多穿点___。
en: If you are cold, just put on more.

q: 他才五岁___，生病了当然会哭。
en: He is only five, after all; of course he cries when he is ill.

q: 下雨就下雨___，我们有雨伞，怕什么。
en: If it rains, then it rains. We have umbrellas, so what is there to fear?

q: 医生早就说过了___，抽烟对身体不好。
en: The doctor said so long ago, you know: smoking is bad for your health.

q: 睡不着就别睡___，起来看会儿书，反正明天不用上班。
en: If you cannot sleep, then do not sleep; get up and read a while, since you do not have to work tomorrow.

q: 夏天本来就热___，你别老抱怨天气，开着空调就是了。
en: Summer is hot by nature, after all; stop always complaining about the weather and just keep the air conditioning on.

q: 你自己都说不舒服了，那就去医院看看___，别在这儿犹豫了。
en: You said yourself you feel unwell, so just go and have it checked at the hospital; stop hesitating.

q: 别担心，你的病会好___。
en: Do not worry, you will get better.

q: 你放心，明天一定会放晴___。
en: Rest assured, it will definitely clear up tomorrow.

q: 吃了药，烧很快就会退___。
en: Once you take the medicine, the fever will soon go down.

q: 我不会忘记吃药___，你不用提醒我。
en: I will not forget to take my medicine; you do not need to remind me.

q: 台风很快就会过去___，大家不要太紧张。
en: The typhoon will pass soon, so everyone, do not be too nervous.

q: 医生说手术很安全，你妈妈一定不会有事___，别一个人在这儿哭了。
en: The doctor said the operation is very safe, so your mother will surely be fine; stop crying here alone.

q: 我的头不疼___。
en: My head does not hurt any more.

q: 天晴___，我们出去玩吧。
en: The sky has cleared; let us go out to play.

q: 她已经不咳嗽___，明天可以上学。
en: She does not cough any more, so she can go to school tomorrow.

q: 秋天到了，树叶都黄___。
en: Autumn has come; the leaves have all turned yellow.

q: 我现在每天跑步，身体比以前好多___。
en: I run every day now, and I am much healthier than before.

q: 孩子的烧退了以后，就不再哭闹___，也肯吃东西了。
en: After the child's fever went down, he stopped crying and fussing and was willing to eat again.

q: 他以前很怕打针，现在长大了，一点儿也不怕___。
en: He used to be very afraid of injections, but now he has grown up and is not afraid at all any more.
It is still raining outside.
Have you been sleeping well lately?
Why don't you go to the hospital for a check-up first.
Spring is warm. What about summer?
You probably did not sleep well last night, I suppose.
I do not eat spicy food any more.
task: Say you do not do it any more.

en: Are you going to the hospital today?
task: Turn it into a yes/no question.

en: It is snowing outside.
task: Say it is snowing right now, with 着 and 呢.

en: Drink more water.
task: Soften it into a gentle suggestion.

en: It definitely will not rain this weekend.
task: Reassure someone: it definitely will not rain this weekend.

你吃药还是打针吗？
你想吃点什么清淡的吗？

你明天有空呢？
这么大的雪，我们怎么回家呢？
我还没吃药了。
雨还没停了，你再等一会儿。
他还没退烧呢，你怎么就让他去上学了？
你多喝点水吧吗。
好吧，我今天不去上班了，在家休息。
你昨晚没睡好吧吗？

今天的天气真好吗！
你快去看医生啊，别再拖了！

别担心，明天一定会晴了。
